text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... I've had a bit of a headache 
for a little while now... But it's nothing 
serious—

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
—All units, do you copy? We will now 
escort Her Highness to the hospital!

text_block_list.name: SP
text_block_list.text:
—Captain! Preparations for the escort are 
complete! Arrangements for the 'Umamusume 
Dock' have also been finalized.

text_block_list.name: Voice over Radio
text_block_list.text:
“—This is Eagle Squad. Dispatching one 
unit to the academy rooftop. ETA is two 
minutes, over.”

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone assume your positions! 
We will now commence the operati—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*! In my name, I order you. Abort the 
operation immediately...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We must not cause a needless scene at the 
academy. It is far too premature to go to 
the hospital over something of this level.

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! My apologies. All units, return to 
standard patrol...!
choice_data_list:
W-Well, let's wait and see how things go 
first.

first.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ow-ow-ow... Raising my voice made it throb 
again...

However, her migraine persisted, and she 
would be plagued by pain for a while 
longer.
